concept.title: HP LaserJet Overview
concept.shortdesc: The HP LaserJet series provides enterprise-grade printing with fast speeds and professional-quality output.

conbody.p: HP LaserJet printers are designed for high-volume printing environments. They support a wide range of paper sizes and media types.

ul.li: Print speeds up to 45 pages per minute
Network-ready with built-in Ethernet and Wi-Fi
HP JetIntelligence toner cartridges for consistent quality
